Doing an audit of the TG Centerlines this morning, it is clear that the target values on the Position Indicator sensors are being retrained across all three machines. Values that were running perfectly last week would now cause the sensors to read as red or out of position and fault the equipment. It is EXTREMELY IMPORTANT that we don't make adjustment to these types of sensors without escalating the reason why. The first thing that should be done each shift is to make sure that the devices are all in centerline. If they are not, operators should attempt to put them back to centerline. If this causes a fault, they need to escalate immediately.  Making adjustments without proper communication hurts our long-term ability to changeover efficiently and return to proper settings if necessary. 
 
Ray Garcia I'm not sure if these changes are being made by the techs, but if they are, we need communication around the adjustments made as our CL sheets are now completely wrong.
